entities.summary: Mon, a notable figure in the history of Myanmar, associated with Mon Kingdoms (300–1057). Preceded by Thaton and Lower Burma Mon Civilization. Their legacy influenced Anawrahta unifies Burma and establishes Theravada Buddhism as the state religion.
